source_control.primary: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 (June 2012)
source_control.current_law_support: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996 for sections 63-64
source_control.note: Items with legal_review_status=pending remain held from release certification until current regulations are checked.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.3 — Dipped beam

en.title: Dipped beam
en.key_point: A dipped-beam headlamp must be adjusted and maintained so that it adequately lights the road ahead.
en.explanation: The official learner manual says dipped beam must allow the driver or rider to see a person, vehicle or substantial object at least 45 metres ahead. This distance remains held for current-regulation verification before release certification.

af.title: Dimbalk
af.key_point: 'n Dimbalkoplig moet so verstel en onderhou word dat dit die pad voor voldoende verlig.
af.explanation: Gebruik dimlig om die pad voor te verlig sonder om ander padgebruikers onnodig te verblind.

xh.title: Isibane esisezantsi
xh.key_point: Isibane esisezantsi kufuneka silungiswe size sigcinwe ukuze sikhanyise indlela engaphambili ngokwaneleyo.
xh.explanation: Sebenzisa isibane esisezantsi ukuze ubone indlela ngaphandle kokukhanyisa ngokugqithisileyo kwabanye abasebenzisi bendlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.4 — Parking lamps

en.title: Parking lamps
en.key_point: Do not drive a moving vehicle on a public road using only its parking lamps.
en.explanation: Parking lamps are not a substitute for the normal lamps required while the vehicle is being driven.

af.title: Parkeerligte
af.key_point: Moenie 'n bewegende voertuig op 'n openbare pad bestuur deur slegs parkeerligte te gebruik nie.
af.explanation: Parkeerligte vervang nie die normale ligte wat tydens bestuur vereis word nie.

xh.title: Izibane zokupaka
xh.key_point: Musa ukuqhuba isithuthi esihambayo endleleni yoluntu usebenzisa kuphela izibane zokupaka.
xh.explanation: Izibane zokupaka azithathi ndawo yezibane eziqhelekileyo ezifunekayo xa uqhuba.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.5 — Rear lamps

en.title: Rear lamps
en.key_point: A motorcycle and a light motor vehicle used on a public road must have rear lighting that shows red to the rear.
en.explanation: Rear lamps make the vehicle visible from behind. The exact current equipment wording is being cross-checked against the operative regulations before final release certification.

af.title: Agterligte
af.key_point: 'n Motorfiets en 'n ligte motorvoertuig op 'n openbare pad moet agterligte hê wat rooi na agter wys.
af.explanation: Agterligte help ander padgebruikers om die voertuig van agter af te sien.

xh.title: Izibane zangasemva
xh.key_point: Isithuthuthu nemoto elula esetyenziswa endleleni yoluntu kufuneka zibe nezibane zangasemva ezibonisa umbala obomvu ngasemva.
xh.explanation: Izibane zangasemva zinceda abanye abasebenzisi bendlela babone isithuthi ngasemva.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.6 — Stop lamp

en.title: Stop lamps
en.key_point: A light motor vehicle or motorcycle used on a public road must have rear stop lamps that show red when braking.
en.explanation: A stop lamp warns following road users that the vehicle is slowing or stopping. Detailed visibility measurements remain under current-regulation verification.

af.title: Remligte
af.key_point: 'n Ligte motorvoertuig of motorfiets op 'n openbare pad moet rooi remligte hê wat wys wanneer gerem word.
af.explanation: Remligte waarsku verkeer agter jou dat jy stadiger ry of stop.

xh.title: Izibane zokuqhobosha
xh.key_point: Imoto elula okanye isithuthuthu endleleni yoluntu kufuneka sibe nezibane ezibomvu ezikhanya xa kuqhoboshwa.
xh.explanation: Ezi zibane zilumkisa izithuthi ezingasemva ukuba uyacotha okanye uyema.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.7 — Number plate lamp

en.title: Number-plate lamp
en.key_point: A motor vehicle used on a public road must have a rear number-plate lamp that illuminates the registration plate.
en.explanation: The purpose is to keep the registration plate visible at night. The manual's exact distance requirement remains under current-regulation verification.

af.title: Nommerplaatlig
af.key_point: 'n Motorvoertuig moet 'n agterste nommerplaatlig hê wat die registrasieplaat verlig.
af.explanation: Die lig help om die registrasieplaat snags leesbaar te hou.

xh.title: Isibane senombolo yobhaliso
xh.key_point: Imoto kufuneka ibe nesibane sangasemva esikhanyisa inombolo yobhaliso.
xh.explanation: Esi sibane sinceda ukuba inombolo yobhaliso ifundeke ebusuku.

source.locator: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996 §63 — Reckless or negligent driving

en.title: Reckless or negligent driving
en.key_point: A person may not drive a vehicle on a public road recklessly or negligently.
en.explanation: Road conditions, traffic, speed and the manner of driving all matter when deciding whether driving was reckless or negligent.

af.title: Roekelose of nalatige bestuur
af.key_point: 'n Persoon mag nie roekeloos of nalatig op 'n openbare pad bestuur nie.
af.explanation: Padtoestande, verkeer, spoed en die manier van bestuur tel alles wanneer veilige bestuur beoordeel word.

xh.title: Ukuqhuba ngokungakhathali okanye ngokungakhathaleli
xh.key_point: Umntu akavumelekanga ukuqhuba isithuthi endleleni yoluntu ngokungakhathali okanye ngokungenankathalo.
xh.explanation: Imeko yendlela, izithuthi, isantya nendlela oqhuba ngayo zonke zibalulekile.

source.locator: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996 §64 — Inconsiderate driving

en.title: Inconsiderate driving
en.key_point: A person may not drive on a public road without reasonable consideration for other people using the road.
en.explanation: Safe driving includes consideration for other road users, not only avoiding a collision or breaking a speed limit.

af.title: Onbedagsame bestuur
af.key_point: 'n Persoon mag nie bestuur sonder redelike agting vir ander padgebruikers nie.
af.explanation: Veilige bestuur beteken ook dat jy ander mense op die pad in ag neem.

xh.title: Ukuqhuba ngaphandle kokuqwalasela abanye
xh.key_point: Umntu akavumelekanga ukuqhuba ngaphandle kokuqwalasela ngokufanelekileyo abanye abasebenzisi bendlela.
xh.explanation: Ukuqhuba ngokukhuselekileyo kuthetha nokucingela abanye abantu endleleni.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.37 — Driving on divided public road

en.title: Driving on a divided public road
en.key_point: Use the left-hand roadway unless a traffic sign or traffic officer directs or permits you to use another roadway.
en.explanation: Where a public road is divided into separate roadways, traffic normally keeps to the left-hand roadway.

af.title: Bestuur op 'n verdeelde openbare pad
af.key_point: Gebruik die linker rybaan tensy 'n verkeersbord of verkeersbeampte jou anders aanwys of toelaat.
af.explanation: Op 'n verdeelde pad bly verkeer normaalweg op die linker rybaan.

xh.title: Ukuqhuba kwindlela yoluntu eyahluliweyo
xh.key_point: Sebenzisa icala lasekhohlo lendlela ngaphandle kokuba uphawu okanye igosa lezendlela likuyalela okanye likuvumela ngenye indlela.
xh.explanation: Kwindlela eyahluliweyo izithuthi zihlala zisebenzisa indlela yasekhohlo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.38 — Driving on left side of roadway

en.title: Keep left on the roadway
en.key_point: Drive on the left side of the roadway and do not unnecessarily encroach into the right half.
en.explanation: Move left safely when another vehicle wants to pass and do not accelerate until it has passed.

af.title: Hou links op die rybaan
af.key_point: Bestuur aan die linkerkant van die rybaan en beweeg nie onnodig in die regterhelfte in nie.
af.explanation: Beweeg veilig links wanneer 'n ander voertuig wil verbysteek en moenie versnel totdat dit verby is nie.

xh.title: Hlala ngasekhohlo endleleni
xh.key_point: Qhuba kwicala lasekhohlo lendlela kwaye ungangeni ngokungeyomfuneko kwicala lasekunene.
xh.explanation: Hamba ngasekhohlo ngokukhuselekileyo xa esinye isithuthi sifuna ukudlula kwaye ungakhawulezisi de sidlule.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.39 — Prohibition on driving on shoulder except in certain circumstances

en.title: Driving on the shoulder
en.key_point: Do not normally drive on the shoulder. A light vehicle may use it only in limited safe circumstances allowed by the rules.
en.explanation: The learner manual describes daytime use while being overtaken, provided it is safe and visibility is adequate. The exact conditions remain under the current-regulation verification gate.

af.title: Bestuur op die skouer
af.key_point: Moenie normaalweg op die padskouer bestuur nie. 'n Ligte voertuig mag dit net in beperkte veilige omstandighede gebruik.
af.explanation: Gebruik die skouer slegs wanneer die reëls dit toelaat en wanneer dit veilig is.

xh.title: Ukuqhuba egxalabeni lendlela
xh.key_point: Musa ukuqhuba egxalabeni lendlela ngokuqhelekileyo. Imoto elula inokulisebenzisa kuphela kwiimeko ezithile ezikhuselekileyo.
xh.explanation: Sebenzisa igxalaba kuphela xa imithetho ivuma kwaye kukhuselekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.40 — Lane changing

en.title: Changing lanes
en.key_point: Change from one marked lane to another only when you can do so without obstructing or endangering other traffic.
en.explanation: Check mirrors and blind spots, signal in good time and move only when there is a safe gap.

af.title: Van baan verander
af.key_point: Verander slegs van een gemerkte baan na 'n ander wanneer jy dit kan doen sonder om verkeer te belemmer of in gevaar te stel.
af.explanation: Kontroleer spieëls en blindekolle, dui betyds aan en beweeg net wanneer daar 'n veilige gaping is.

xh.title: Ukutshintsha iilayini
xh.key_point: Tshintsha ukusuka kwenye ilayini ephawulweyo uye kwenye kuphela xa ungathinteli okanye ubeke ezinye izithuthi emngciphekweni.
xh.explanation: Jonga izibuko neendawo ezingabonakaliyo, bonisa kwangethuba uze utshintshe kuphela xa kukho indawo ekhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.42 — Direction indicators

en.title: Direction indicators
en.key_point: Use direction indicators when turning or changing lanes.
en.explanation: Indicators communicate your intended movement to other road users. Vehicle-equipment details remain subject to the current-regulation check.

af.title: Rigtingwysers
af.key_point: Gebruik rigtingwysers wanneer jy draai of van baan verander.
af.explanation: Rigtingwysers wys ander padgebruikers wat jy van plan is om te doen.

xh.title: Izalathisi zokujika
xh.key_point: Sebenzisa izalathisi xa ujika okanye utshintsha ilayini.
xh.explanation: Izalathisi zixelela abanye abasebenzisi bendlela into oceba ukuyenza.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.43.1 — Motorcycle retro-reflector

en.title: Motorcycle rear reflector
en.key_point: A motorcycle used on a public road must have a red retro-reflector fitted at the rear.
en.explanation: The reflector helps other road users see the motorcycle from behind in low-light conditions.

af.title: Motorfiets se agterste weerkaatser
af.key_point: 'n Motorfiets op 'n openbare pad moet 'n rooi weerkaatser aan die agterkant hê.
af.explanation: Die weerkaatser help om die motorfiets in swak lig van agter af sigbaar te maak.

xh.title: Isibonakalisi sangasemva sesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Isithuthuthu endleleni yoluntu kufuneka sibe nesibonakalisi esibomvu ngasemva.
xh.explanation: Isibonakalisi sinceda ukuba isithuthuthu sibonakale ngasemva xa ukukhanya kubuthathaka.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.43.2 — Light motor vehicle retro-reflectors

en.title: Light-vehicle rear reflectors
en.key_point: A light motor vehicle must have red retro-reflectors at the rear.
en.explanation: The learner manual specifies one on each side. The exact current equipment wording is being checked against operative regulations.

af.title: Ligte voertuig se agterste weerkaatsers
af.key_point: 'n Ligte motorvoertuig moet rooi weerkaatsers aan die agterkant hê.
af.explanation: Die weerkaatsers verbeter die voertuig se sigbaarheid van agter af.

xh.title: Izibonakalisi zangasemva zemoto elula
xh.key_point: Imoto elula kufuneka ibe nezibonakalisi ezibomvu ngasemva.
xh.explanation: Izibonakalisi zenza imoto ibonakale ngcono ngasemva.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.45 — Overtaking/passing, limited left-passing exceptions

en.title: Passing on the left
en.key_point: Overtaking is normally on the right. Passing on the left is allowed only in specific safe situations permitted by the rules.
en.explanation: Do not treat the left side as a general overtaking lane. The detailed exceptions remain tied to the official rule set and current-regulation check.

af.title: Aan die linkerkant verbygaan
af.key_point: Verbysteek is normaalweg aan die regterkant. Verbygaan links word net in spesifieke veilige gevalle toegelaat.
af.explanation: Moenie die linkerkant as 'n gewone verbysteekbaan gebruik nie.

xh.title: Ukudlula ngasekhohlo
xh.key_point: Ukudlula kuqhele ukwenziwa ngasekunene. Ukudlula ngasekhohlo kuvumelekile kuphela kwiimeko ezithile ezikhuselekileyo.
xh.explanation: Musa ukuphatha icala lasekhohlo njengendawo eqhelekileyo yokudlula.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.50 — Duties relating to motorcycles

en.title: Motorcycle rider control
en.key_point: Ride so that you maintain complete control of the motorcycle and a clear view of the road and traffic.
en.explanation: Baggage must be carried so that it does not obstruct your view or prevent proper control.

af.title: Beheer van 'n motorfiets
af.key_point: Ry so dat jy volle beheer oor die motorfiets en 'n duidelike uitsig oor die pad en verkeer behou.
af.explanation: Bagasie mag nie jou uitsig of beheer oor die motorfiets belemmer nie.

xh.title: Ulawulo lwesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Khwela ngendlela egcina ulawulo olupheleleyo lwesithuthuthu kunye nombono ocacileyo wendlela nezithuthi.
xh.explanation: Imithwalo mayingavali umbono wakho okanye iphazamise ulawulo lwesithuthuthu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.50 — Rider/passenger must not take hold of another moving vehicle

en.title: Do not hold onto another moving vehicle
en.key_point: A motorcycle rider or passenger must not take hold of another vehicle that is moving.
en.explanation: The motorcycle must be controlled independently and safely at all times.

af.title: Moenie aan 'n ander bewegende voertuig vashou nie
af.key_point: 'n Motorfietsryer of passasier mag nie aan 'n ander voertuig wat beweeg vashou nie.
af.explanation: Die motorfiets moet onafhanklik en veilig beheer word.

xh.title: Musa ukubambelela kwesinye isithuthi esihambayo
xh.key_point: Umkhweli okanye umgibeli wesithuthuthu akavumelekanga ukubambelela kwesinye isithuthi esihambayo.
xh.explanation: Isithuthuthu kufuneka silawulwe ngokuzimeleyo nangokukhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.50 — Motorcycles in single file, subject to overtaking rule

en.title: Motorcycles travelling together
en.key_point: Motorcycles travelling in the same lane should ride in single file, except as allowed while overtaking.
en.explanation: The rule reduces conflict between motorcycles sharing the same lane and other road users.

af.title: Motorfietse wat saam ry
af.key_point: Motorfietse wat in dieselfde baan ry, moet enkelgelid ry, behalwe waar verbysteek toegelaat word.
af.explanation: Dit help om konflik tussen motorfietse en ander padgebruikers te verminder.

xh.title: Izithuthuthu ezihamba kunye
xh.key_point: Izithuthuthu ezihamba kwilayini enye kufuneka zihambe ngomgca omnye, ngaphandle xa ukudlula kuvumelekile.
xh.explanation: Oku kunceda ukunciphisa ungquzulwano phakathi kwezithuthuthu nabanye abasebenzisi bendlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.51 — Sidecar attachment

en.title: Motorcycle sidecar
en.key_point: A sidecar used on a public road must be attached on the correct side of the motorcycle.
en.explanation: The learner manual specifies the left side and contains an engine-capacity condition. Those equipment details remain under current-regulation verification.

af.title: Motorfiets-syspan
af.key_point: 'n Syspan wat op 'n openbare pad gebruik word, moet aan die korrekte kant van die motorfiets vasgemaak wees.
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding plaas die syspan aan die linkerkant; besonderhede bly onder regsverifikasie.

xh.title: I-sidecar yesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: I-sidecar esetyenziswa endleleni yoluntu kufuneka ifakwe kwicala elichanekileyo lesithuthuthu.
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ibeka i-sidecar kwicala lasekhohlo; iinkcukacha zisaphantsi kovavanyo lomthetho.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.54 — Vehicle left/abandoned

en.title: Leaving a vehicle on a public road
en.key_point: Do not leave a vehicle standing indefinitely on a public road.
en.explanation: The learner manual sets different time periods inside and outside urban areas. Those exact periods remain under the current-regulation verification gate before release certification.

af.title: Om 'n voertuig op 'n openbare pad te laat
af.key_point: Moenie 'n voertuig vir 'n onbepaalde tyd op 'n openbare pad laat staan nie.
af.explanation: Die presiese tydperke verskil volgens ligging en moet volgens die toepaslike reëls gevolg word.

xh.title: Ukushiya isithuthi endleleni yoluntu
xh.key_point: Musa ukushiya isithuthi simile endleleni yoluntu ixesha elingenasiphelo.
xh.explanation: Amaxesha achanekileyo ayahluka ngokwendawo kwaye kufuneka kulandelwe imithetho esebenzayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.55 — Damage to public roads

en.title: Do not damage the road
en.key_point: Do not operate or move a vehicle in a way that damages the roadway.
en.explanation: The manual also prohibits deliberately dragging or spinning wheels on the road except in an emergency.

af.title: Moenie die pad beskadig nie
af.key_point: Moenie 'n voertuig gebruik of beweeg op 'n manier wat die rybaan beskadig nie.
af.explanation: Moenie wiele doelbewus sleep of laat tol op 'n manier wat die pad beskadig nie, behalwe waar noodoptrede nodig is.

xh.title: Musa ukonakalisa indlela
xh.key_point: Musa ukusebenzisa okanye ukuhambisa isithuthi ngendlela eyonakalisa indlela.
xh.explanation: Musa ukurhuqa okanye ukujikelezisa amavili ngenjongo ngendlela eyonakalisa indlela, ngaphandle kwemeko engxamisekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.56 — Freeways: prohibited vehicles/users

en.title: Who may use a freeway
en.key_point: Not every road user or vehicle is allowed on a freeway.
en.explanation: The official learner manual excludes several slow or unsuitable road users and vehicle types. Exact category thresholds remain under current-regulation verification.

af.title: Wie mag 'n snelweg gebruik
af.key_point: Nie elke padgebruiker of voertuig word op 'n snelweg toegelaat nie.
af.explanation: Sekere stadige of ongeskikte voertuie en padgebruikers word uitgesluit. Volg die snelwegreëls en tekens.

xh.title: Ngubani onokusebenzisa indlela enkulu
xh.key_point: Ayinguye wonke umsebenzisi wendlela okanye isithuthi esivumelekileyo kwindlela enkulu.
xh.explanation: Ezinye izithuthi ezicothayo okanye ezingafanelekanga kunye nabasebenzisi bendlela azivumelekanga. Landela imithetho nemiqondiso yendlela enkulu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.56 — Freeway stopping, pedestrians/animals and merging

en.title: Freeway behaviour
en.key_point: Do not stop on a freeway except where the rules allow it, and remain alert to vehicles merging from on-ramps.
en.explanation: The manual also restricts pedestrians and animals on freeways and requires drivers to allow a vehicle ahead to merge safely from an on-ramp.

af.title: Gedrag op 'n snelweg
af.key_point: Moenie op 'n snelweg stop nie, behalwe waar die reëls dit toelaat, en let op voertuie wat vanaf opritte invoeg.
af.explanation: Bestuur vooruitdenkend, hou veilige afstand en laat veilige invoeging toe waar nodig.

xh.title: Indlela yokuziphatha kwindlela enkulu
xh.key_point: Musa ukuma kwindlela enkulu ngaphandle apho imithetho ivuma khona, kwaye qaphela izithuthi ezidibanayo zisuka kwi-on-ramp.
xh.explanation: Qhuba ucinga phambili, gcina umgama okhuselekileyo kwaye vumela ukudibana kwezithuthi ngokukhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.8 — Number plates

en.title: Number plates
en.key_point: Number plates must be fitted in the prescribed positions and must be clearly legible and visible.
en.explanation: The learner manual places a plate at the rear of a motorcycle, motor tricycle or trailer, and at both the front and rear of other motor vehicles.

af.title: Nommerplate
af.key_point: Nommerplate moet in die voorgeskrewe posisies aangebring word en duidelik leesbaar en sigbaar wees.
af.explanation: Motorfietse het die registrasieplaat agter; ander voertuie het plate waar die reëls dit vereis.

xh.title: Iipleyiti zenombolo
xh.key_point: Iipleyiti zenombolo kufuneka zibekwe kwiindawo ezimiselweyo kwaye zifundeke zize zibonakale kakuhle.
xh.explanation: Izithuthuthu zinenombolo yobhaliso ngasemva; ezinye izithuthi zineepleyiti apho imithetho ifuna khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.9 — Fog lamps

en.title: Fog lamps
en.key_point: Fog lamps should be used only when visibility is poor because of conditions such as fog, mist, dust, smoke or snow.
en.explanation: Do not use fog lamps as ordinary driving lights in clear conditions.

af.title: Misligte
af.key_point: Gebruik misligte slegs wanneer sigbaarheid swak is weens toestande soos mis, stof, rook of swaar weer.
af.explanation: Moenie misligte as gewone ryligte in helder toestande gebruik nie.

xh.title: Izibane zenkungu
xh.key_point: Sebenzisa izibane zenkungu kuphela xa ukubona kubuthathaka ngenxa yenkungu, uthuli, umsi okanye imozulu embi.
xh.explanation: Musa ukuzisebenzisa njengezibane eziqhelekileyo xa indlela icacile.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.10 — Spot lamp

en.title: Spot lamps
en.key_point: An adjustable spot lamp is not for ordinary unrestricted road use.
en.explanation: The learner manual limits adjustable spot-lamp use to specified official, emergency, professional and essential-service purposes.

af.title: Soekligte
af.key_point: 'n Verstelbare soeklig is nie vir gewone onbeperkte gebruik op openbare paaie bedoel nie.
af.explanation: Gebruik soekligte slegs waar die wet of 'n toegelate diens dit voorsien.

xh.title: Izibane zokukhangela
xh.key_point: Isibane sokukhangela esilungisekayo asenzelwanga ukusetyenziswa okuqhelekileyo okungenamda endleleni yoluntu.
xh.explanation: Sisebenzise kuphela apho umthetho okanye inkonzo egunyazisiweyo ivuma khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.11 — Driving view unobstructed / rear-view mirrors

en.title: Clear driving view and mirrors
en.key_point: The driver or rider must have a clear view ahead and to both sides and must be able to see traffic behind using suitable mirrors.
en.explanation: For light vehicles, the learner manual explains the required exterior/interior mirror arrangement and the additional exterior mirror needed when an interior mirror cannot give a clear rear view.

af.title: Duidelike uitsig en spieëls
af.key_point: Die bestuurder of ryer moet 'n duidelike uitsig vorentoe en na beide kante hê en verkeer agter met geskikte spieëls kan sien.
af.explanation: Spieëls en die vooruitsig moet nie so geblokkeer wees dat veilige bestuur belemmer word nie.

xh.title: Umbono ocacileyo nezibuko
xh.key_point: Umqhubi okanye umkhweli kufuneka abe nombono ocacileyo phambili nasemacaleni kwaye abone izithuthi ezingasemva ngezibuko ezifanelekileyo.
xh.explanation: Izibuko nombono wangaphambili akufanele kuthintelwe ngendlela ephazamisa ukuqhuba ngokukhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.12.1 — Motorcycle steering gear

en.title: Motorcycle steering gear
en.key_point: Motorcycle steering gear must allow safe and efficient steering and the handlebars must comply with the official dimensions.
en.explanation: The learner manual states handlebar widths of 600–800 mm for motorcycles of 200 cc or more, and 500–800 mm below 200 cc, with limits on handgrip height relative to the seat.

af.title: Motorfiets-stuurmeganisme
af.key_point: Die motorfiets se stuurmeganisme moet veilige en doeltreffende stuur moontlik maak en die handvatsels moet aan die vereistes voldoen.
af.explanation: Die amptelike leerdermateriaal gee afmetings vir handvatselwydte en -hoogte. Hierdie besonderhede moet as bronwaardes behandel word.

xh.title: Inkqubo yokujika yesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Inkqubo yokujika yesithuthuthu kufuneka ivumele ukujika ngokukhuselekileyo nangempumelelo kwaye iziphatho zihambelane neemfuno.
xh.explanation: Izinto zomfundi ezisemthethweni zinika imilinganiselo yeziphatho. Ezi nkcukacha ziphathwa njengamaxabiso omthombo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.12.2 — Light motor vehicle steering gear

en.title: Light-vehicle steering gear
en.key_point: All steering parts must be maintained so that the vehicle can be steered safely and efficiently.
en.explanation: A vehicle with defective steering must not be used on a public road.

af.title: Ligte voertuig se stuurmeganisme
af.key_point: Alle stuuronderdele moet so onderhou word dat die voertuig veilig en doeltreffend bestuur kan word.
af.explanation: 'n Voertuig met gebrekkige stuurwerk mag nie op 'n openbare pad gebruik word nie.

xh.title: Inkqubo yokujika yemoto elula
xh.key_point: Zonke iinxalenye zokujika kufuneka zigcinwe ukuze imoto ikwazi ukuqhutywa ngokukhuselekileyo nangempumelelo.
xh.explanation: Imoto enenkqubo yokujika engasebenzi kakuhle akufanele isetyenziswe endleleni yoluntu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.13 — Turning radius

en.title: Turning radius
en.key_point: The learner manual states that a motor vehicle used on a public road may not have a turning radius exceeding 13.1 metres.
en.explanation: This is part of the published vehicle-roadworthiness study material.

af.title: Draairadius
af.key_point: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat 'n motorvoertuig op 'n openbare pad nie 'n draairadius van meer as 13,1 meter mag hê nie.
af.explanation: Dit vorm deel van die gepubliseerde voertuig-padwaardigheidsmateriaal.

xh.title: Iradiyasi yokujika
xh.key_point: Incwadi yomfundi ithi isithuthi endleleni yoluntu asimele sibe neradiyasi yokujika engaphezu kwe-13,1 yeemitha.
xh.explanation: Oku kuyinxalenye yezinto ezipapashiweyo malunga nokufaneleka kwesithuthi endleleni.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.14.1 — Motorcycle brakes

en.title: Motorcycle braking systems
en.key_point: A motorcycle must have two independent braking systems: one acting on the front wheel and one on the rear wheel or wheels.
en.explanation: Both braking systems must be in proper working order.

af.title: Motorfiets-remstelsels
af.key_point: 'n Motorfiets moet twee onafhanklike remstelsels hê: een vir die voorwiel en een vir die agterwiel of -wiele.
af.explanation: Albei remstelsels moet in goeie werkende toestand wees.

xh.title: Iinkqubo zokuqhobosha zesithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Isithuthuthu kufuneka sibe neenkqubo ezimbini ezizimeleyo zokuqhobosha: enye kwivili langaphambili nenye kwivili okanye kumavili angasemva.
xh.explanation: Zombini iinkqubo zokuqhobosha kufuneka zisebenze kakuhle.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.19 — Windscreen

en.title: Windscreen
en.key_point: The windscreen must provide enough visibility for safe driving and must be made of safety glass.
en.explanation: The learner manual also states a minimum visible-light transmittance of 70 percent through the windscreen.

af.title: Voorruit
af.key_point: Die voorruit moet genoeg sig vir veilige bestuur bied en van veiligheidsglas gemaak wees.
af.explanation: Hou die voorruit skoon en vry van skade wat jou uitsig kan belemmer.

xh.title: I-windscreen
xh.key_point: I-windscreen kufuneka inike umbono owaneleyo wokuqhuba ngokukhuselekileyo kwaye yenziwe ngeglasi yokhuseleko.
xh.explanation: Gcina i-windscreen icocekile kwaye ingenamonakalo onokuphazamisa umbono wakho.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.20 — Windscreen wipers

en.title: Windscreen wipers
en.key_point: A vehicle with a windscreen must have at least one effective windscreen wiper.
en.explanation: The wiper must clear the outside of the windscreen directly in front of the driver continuously and adequately.

af.title: Voorruitveërs
af.key_point: 'n Voertuig met 'n voorruit moet minstens een doeltreffende voorruitveër hê.
af.explanation: Die veër moet die gedeelte voor die bestuurder voldoende skoonmaak.

xh.title: Ii-wiper ze-windscreen
xh.key_point: Isithuthi esine-windscreen kufuneka sibe nobuncinane i-wiper enye esebenzayo.
xh.explanation: I-wiper kufuneka icoce ngokwaneleyo indawo ephambi komqhubi.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.21 — Exhaust silencers / exhaust pipes

en.title: Exhaust system
en.key_point: A motor vehicle must have an effective exhaust silencer and must not emit exhaust in a way that creates danger, nuisance or obstructed visibility.
en.explanation: The exhaust system must also be positioned and maintained so that fumes do not leak into the driver or passenger area.

af.title: Uitlaatstelsel
af.key_point: 'n Motorvoertuig moet 'n doeltreffende uitlaatdemper hê en mag nie uitlaatgasse op 'n gevaarlike of hinderlike manier vrystel nie.
af.explanation: Die uitlaatstelsel moet goed onderhou word en nie uitlaatgasse in die bestuurder- of passasiersruimte laat lek nie.

xh.title: Inkqubo yokukhupha umsi
xh.key_point: Isithuthi kufuneka sibe nesinciphisi-ngxolo esisebenzayo kwaye singakhuphi umsi ngendlela eyingozi okanye ephazamisayo.
xh.explanation: Inkqubo yokukhupha umsi kufuneka igcinwe kakuhle kwaye ingavumeli umsi ungene kwindawo yomqhubi okanye yabakhweli.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.22 — Fuel tank, electrical wiring and battery

en.title: Fuel system, wiring and battery
en.key_point: Fuel-system parts, electrical wiring and the battery must be safely installed, maintained and not create a source of danger.
en.explanation: The fuel tank must also have an effective cap.

af.title: Brandstofstelsel, bedrading en battery
af.key_point: Brandstofonderdele, elektriese bedrading en die battery moet veilig geïnstalleer en onderhou word en mag nie gevaar veroorsaak nie.
af.explanation: Die brandstoftenk moet ook 'n doeltreffende dop hê.

xh.title: Inkqubo yamafutha, iingcingo nombane webhetri
xh.key_point: Iinxalenye zamafutha, iingcingo zombane nebhetri kufuneka zifakwe zize zigcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo kwaye zingabi ngumthombo wengozi.
xh.explanation: Itanki yamafutha kufuneka ibe nesivalo esisebenzayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.23 — Engine

en.title: Engine safety
en.key_point: A light motor vehicle must have its engine covered so that it is not a source of danger.
en.explanation: This forms part of the official learner roadworthiness material.

af.title: Enjinveiligheid
af.key_point: 'n Ligte motorvoertuig se enjin moet bedek wees sodat dit nie 'n bron van gevaar is nie.
af.explanation: Dit vorm deel van die amptelike leerdermateriaal oor voertuigveiligheid.

xh.title: Ukhuseleko lwenjini
xh.key_point: Injini yemoto elula kufuneka igqunywe ukuze ingabi ngumthombo wengozi.
xh.explanation: Oku kuyinxalenye yezinto ezisemthethweni zomfundi malunga nokhuseleko lwesithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.24 — Emergency warning signs (triangles)

en.title: Emergency warning triangle
en.key_point: Certain goods vehicles, minibuses, buses and heavy vehicles must carry an emergency warning triangle; ordinary motor cars and motorcycles are excluded in the learner manual.
en.explanation: When required for a stationary vehicle, the manual places the triangle at least 45 metres away in the direction from which traffic approaches, with the reflective side facing approaching traffic.

af.title: Noodwaarskuwingsdriehoek
af.key_point: Sekere goederevoertuie, minibusse, busse en swaar voertuie moet 'n noodwaarskuwingsdriehoek dra; gewone motors en motorfietse word in die leerderhandleiding uitgesluit.
af.explanation: Wanneer dit vereis word, moet die driehoek so geplaas word dat naderende verkeer betyds gewaarsku word.

xh.title: Unxantathu wesilumkiso sengxamiseko
xh.key_point: Ezinye iilori, i-minibus, iibhasi nezithuthi ezinzima kufuneka ziphathe unxantathu wesilumkiso; iimoto eziqhelekileyo nezithuthuthu azibandakanywa kwincwadi yomfundi.
xh.explanation: Xa kufuneka, unxantathu kufuneka ubekwe ukuze izithuthi ezisondelayo zilumkiswe kwangethuba.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.25 — Excessive noise

en.title: Excessive vehicle noise
en.key_point: Do not operate a vehicle on a public road in a way that causes excessive noise.
en.explanation: This rule applies to both riders and drivers.

af.title: Oormatige voertuiggeraas
af.key_point: Moenie 'n voertuig op 'n openbare pad gebruik op 'n manier wat oormatige geraas veroorsaak nie.
af.explanation: Die reël geld vir bestuurders sowel as motorfietsryers.

xh.title: Ingxolo egqithisileyo yesithuthi
xh.key_point: Musa ukusebenzisa isithuthi endleleni yoluntu ngendlela ebangela ingxolo egqithisileyo.
xh.explanation: Lo mgaqo usebenza kubo bonke abaqhubi nabakhweli bezithuthuthu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.26 — Speedometers

en.title: Speedometer
en.key_point: A motor vehicle designed for or capable of 60 km/h or more must have a speedometer in good working order.
en.explanation: The speedometer allows the driver or rider to monitor road speed.

af.title: Spoedmeter
af.key_point: 'n Motorvoertuig wat vir 60 km/h of meer ontwerp is of dit kan bereik, moet 'n werkende spoedmeter hê.
af.explanation: Die spoedmeter help die bestuurder of ryer om padsnelheid te monitor.

xh.title: Isilinganisi-santya
xh.key_point: Isithuthi esenzelwe okanye esinokufikelela kwi-60 km/h nangaphezulu kufuneka sibe nesilinganisi-santya esisebenzayo.
xh.explanation: Isilinganisi-santya sinceda umqhubi okanye umkhweli alandele isantya endleleni.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.28 — Passenger vehicles conveying persons for reward

en.title: Passenger vehicles for reward
en.key_point: The learner manual states a 100 km/h maximum for a bus or minibus conveying passengers for reward.
en.explanation: This is a vehicle-class rule and does not replace a lower posted speed limit.

af.title: Passasiersvoertuie teen vergoeding
af.key_point: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal 'n maksimum van 100 km/h vir 'n bus of minibus wat passasiers teen vergoeding vervoer.
af.explanation: 'n Laer aangeplakte spoedgrens bly van toepassing waar dit aangedui word.

xh.title: Izithuthi zabakhweli ezisebenza ngemali
xh.key_point: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ubuninzi be-100 km/h kwibhasi okanye i-minibus ethutha abakhweli ngemali.
xh.explanation: Umda wesantya osezantsi oboniswe kuphawu usasebenza apho ubekwe khona.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.30 — Overall length of vehicles

en.title: Overall vehicle length
en.key_point: Vehicle length is legally limited by vehicle type.
en.explanation: For the ordinary 'other vehicle' category in the learner manual, overall length may not exceed 12.5 metres. Longer limits apply to specified trailers, articulated vehicles, bus-trains and vehicle combinations.

af.title: Totale voertuiglengte
af.key_point: Die wettige voertuiglengte word volgens voertuigtipe beperk.
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding gee verskillende maksimum lengtes vir gewone voertuie, sleepwaens, geartikuleerde voertuie en voertuigkombinasies.

xh.title: Ubude obupheleleyo besithuthi
xh.key_point: Ubude besithuthi bukhawulelwe ngokohlobo lwesithuthi.
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi inika imida eyahlukeneyo kwiimoto eziqhelekileyo, ii-trailer, izithuthi ezidibeneyo neendibaniselwano zezithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.31 — Overall height of vehicle

en.title: Overall vehicle height
en.key_point: For vehicles other than a double-deck bus, the learner manual states a maximum overall height of 4.3 metres including the load.
en.explanation: A double-deck bus has a separate published limit.

af.title: Totale voertuighoogte
af.key_point: Vir voertuie anders as 'n dubbeldekbus bepaal die leerderhandleiding 'n maksimum hoogte van 4,3 meter, vrag ingesluit.
af.explanation: 'n Dubbeldekbus het 'n afsonderlike gepubliseerde limiet.

xh.title: Ukuphakama okupheleleyo kwesithuthi
xh.key_point: Kwizithuthi ezingeyiyo ibhasi enamanqanaba amabini, incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuphakama okuphezulu kwe-4,3 yeemitha kuquka nomthwalo.
xh.explanation: Ibhasi enamanqanaba amabini inomda owahlukileyo opapashiweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.32 — Overall width of vehicles

en.title: Overall vehicle width
en.key_point: For the ordinary 'other vehicle' category, the learner manual states a maximum overall width of 2.5 metres.
en.explanation: Specified buses and large goods vehicles have a separate 2.6-metre rule.

af.title: Totale voertuigbreedte
af.key_point: Vir die gewone kategorie 'ander voertuig' bepaal die leerderhandleiding 'n maksimum breedte van 2,5 meter.
af.explanation: Sekere busse en groot goederevoertuie het 'n afsonderlike limiet.

xh.title: Ububanzi obupheleleyo besithuthi
xh.key_point: Kudidi oluqhelekileyo 'lwesinye isithuthi', incwadi yomfundi ichaza ububanzi obuphezulu be-2,5 yeemitha.
xh.explanation: Ezinye iibhasi neelori ezinkulu zinemida eyahlukileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.33 — Conveyance of goods

en.title: Loads on a light vehicle
en.key_point: Loads must be secure, must not touch the road or block the driver's view, and must stay within the official load limits.
en.explanation: The learner manual also limits the height of ordinary goods carried on a motor-car roof to half the vehicle's height, with an exception for bicycles carried on the roof.

af.title: Vragte op 'n ligte voertuig
af.key_point: Vrag moet veilig vas wees, mag nie die pad raak of die bestuurder se uitsig blokkeer nie, en moet binne die amptelike perke bly.
af.explanation: Bevestig alle vrag sodat dit nie kan skuif, afval of die voertuig onveilig maak nie.

xh.title: Imithwalo kwimimoto elula
xh.key_point: Umthwalo kufuneka ubotshelelwe kakuhle, ungachukumisi indlela okanye uvale umbono womqhubi, kwaye uhlale kwimida esemthethweni.
xh.explanation: Qinisekisa wonke umthwalo ukuze ungashukumi, uwe okanye wenze isithuthi singakhuseleki.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.34 — Persons carried on goods vehicle

en.title: Persons on a goods vehicle
en.key_point: If people are carried on a goods vehicle, the carrying area must have protective enclosure of the height stated in the learner manual.
en.explanation: The manual states at least 350 mm above a seated person’s surface or 900 mm above a standing surface, and says passengers may not ride in a caravan.

af.title: Persone op 'n goederevoertuig
af.key_point: Waar persone op 'n goederevoertuig vervoer word, moet die laairuimte die beskermende omhulsel hê wat die leerderhandleiding vereis.
af.explanation: Die beskerming moet geskik wees vir mense wat sit of staan; passasiers mag nie in 'n karavaan ry nie.

xh.title: Abantu kwisithuthi sempahla
xh.key_point: Xa abantu bethuthwa kwisithuthi sempahla, indawo yokuthwala kufuneka ibe nokhuselo oluchazwe kwincwadi yomfundi.
xh.explanation: Ukhuselo kufuneka lufanele abantu abahleliyo okanye abamileyo; abakhweli akufanele bakhwele kwi-caravan.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.35 — Motorcycle projections / overhang

en.title: Motorcycle load projections
en.key_point: Goods on a motorcycle or sidecar must stay within the official projection limits.
en.explanation: The learner manual states no more than 600 mm in front of the front axle, 900 mm behind the rear axle, 450 mm beyond either side of the motorcycle wheels, and 300 mm beyond the outside of a sidecar wheel.

af.title: Motorfiets se vraguitsteeksels
af.key_point: Goedere op 'n motorfiets of syspan moet binne die amptelike uitsteekperke bly.
af.explanation: Meet die vrag teen die voor-, agter- en sykante en maak seker dit bly binne die gepubliseerde perke.

xh.title: Ukuphuma komthwalo kwisithuthuthu
xh.key_point: Impahla kwisithuthuthu okanye kwi-sidecar kufuneka ihlale kwimida esemthethweni yokuphuma.
xh.explanation: Jonga umthwalo ngaphambili, ngasemva nasemacaleni ukuze uhlale kwimida epapashiweyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.35 — Light vehicle projections / overhang

en.title: Light-vehicle load projections
en.key_point: A load on an ordinary light vehicle must stay within the official side, front and rear projection limits.
en.explanation: The learner manual gives 1.25 m from the centre line to either side, 300 mm beyond the front and 1.8 m beyond the rear, with a separate 150 mm limit for brackets beyond the widest part.

af.title: Ligte voertuig se vraguitsteeksels
af.key_point: 'n Vrag op 'n gewone ligte voertuig moet binne die amptelike sy-, voor- en agteruitsteekperke bly.
af.explanation: Beplan en beveilig die vrag voordat jy ry sodat dit nie te ver uitsteek nie.

xh.title: Ukuphuma komthwalo kwimimoto elula
xh.key_point: Umthwalo kwimimoto elula kufuneka uhlale kwimida esemthethweni emacaleni, ngaphambili nangasemva.
xh.explanation: Cwangcisa uze ubophe umthwalo ngaphambi kokuhamba ukuze ungaphumi kakhulu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.36 — Warning flags / reflectors

en.title: Marking a projecting load
en.key_point: A load projecting more than the published limits must be marked so other road users can see it.
en.explanation: The learner manual requires a red 300 mm × 300 mm flag by day where a load projects more than 150 mm to the side or 300 mm to the rear, and white front/red rear reflectors at night or in poor visibility.

af.title: Merk 'n uitstaande vrag
af.key_point: 'n Vrag wat verder as die gepubliseerde perke uitsteek, moet gemerk word sodat ander padgebruikers dit kan sien.
af.explanation: Gebruik die vereiste waarskuwingsmerke, vlae of weerkaatsers volgens die omstandighede.

xh.title: Phawula umthwalo ophumayo
xh.key_point: Umthwalo ophuma ngaphaya kwemida epapashiweyo kufuneka uphawulwe ukuze ubonakale kwabanye abasebenzisi bendlela.
xh.explanation: Sebenzisa iiflegi, iziphawuli okanye izibonakalisi ezifunekayo ngokwemeko.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.46 — Intersections / traffic-circle right of way

en.title: Intersections and right of way
en.key_point: At an uncontrolled traffic circle or similar junction, yield to traffic approaching from the right unless a traffic officer or sign gives a different instruction.
en.explanation: Always obey traffic officers and traffic signs when they control the intersection.

af.title: Kruisings en voorrang
af.key_point: By 'n onbeheerde verkeersirkel of soortgelyke aansluiting moet jy toegee aan verkeer wat van regs nader, tensy 'n beampte of teken anders bepaal.
af.explanation: Volg altyd verkeersbeamptes en tekens wanneer hulle die kruising beheer.

xh.title: Iindlela ezinqamlezanayo nelungelo lokudlula
xh.key_point: Kwi-traffic circle engalawulwayo okanye kwindawo efanayo, nika indlela kwizithuthi ezisondela ngasekunene ngaphandle kokuba igosa okanye uphawu luthi ngenye indlela.
xh.explanation: Soloko ulandela igosa lezendlela nemiqondiso xa zilawula indawo yokudibana.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.47 — Parking

en.title: Parking restrictions
en.key_point: Do not park where a sign prohibits it, where you block access or visibility, or within the official distances and restricted places listed in the learner manual.
en.explanation: Examples include within 1.5 m of a fire hydrant, within 9 m before a pedestrian crossing, within 5 m of an intersection, on a traffic island or pedestrian area, or where the road is too narrow.

af.title: Parkeerbeperkings
af.key_point: Moenie parkeer waar 'n teken dit verbied, waar jy toegang of sig blokkeer, of binne verbode plekke en afstande nie.
af.explanation: Let veral op kruisings, voetoorgange, brandkrane, verkeerseilande en nou paaie.

xh.title: Imiqathango yokupaka
xh.key_point: Musa ukupaka apho uphawu luyakwalela, apho uvala ukufikelela okanye umbono, okanye kwiindawo nemigama ethintelweyo.
xh.explanation: Qaphela ngakumbi iindlela ezinqamlezanayo, iindawo zabahambi ngeenyawo, ii-hydrant, iziqithi zendlela neendlela ezimxinwa.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.48 — Stopping

en.title: Stopping restrictions
en.key_point: Do not stop on the roadway where stopping would obstruct or endanger other traffic, unless stopping is necessary for safety, required by an officer or beyond your control.
en.explanation: Stopping restrictions are stricter than ordinary parking rules because even a short stop can create a hazard.

af.title: Stopbeperkings
af.key_point: Moenie op die rybaan stop waar dit ander verkeer sal belemmer of in gevaar stel nie, behalwe waar stop vir veiligheid of volgens 'n bevel nodig is.
af.explanation: Selfs 'n kort stop kan gevaarlik wees as dit verkeer se sig of beweging blokkeer.

xh.title: Imiqathango yokuma
xh.key_point: Musa ukuma endleleni apho oko kuya kuthintela okanye kubeke ezinye izithuthi emngciphekweni, ngaphandle xa kufuneka ngenxa yokhuseleko okanye umyalelo.
xh.explanation: Nokuba kukuma okufutshane kunokuba yingozi xa kuvala umbono okanye ukuhamba kwezithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.49 — General duties of driver/rider

en.title: General duties of a driver or rider
en.key_point: Maintain control, keep a safe following distance, reverse only when safe and avoid actions that obstruct your view or control.
en.explanation: These general duties apply even where no separate sign is present.

af.title: Algemene pligte van 'n bestuurder of ryer
af.key_point: Behou beheer, hou 'n veilige volgafstand, ry net agteruit wanneer dit veilig is en vermy enigiets wat jou uitsig of beheer belemmer.
af.explanation: Hierdie algemene pligte geld selfs wanneer daar nie 'n spesifieke verkeersteken is nie.

xh.title: Imisebenzi jikelele yomqhubi okanye umkhweli
xh.key_point: Gcina ulawulo, gcina umgama okhuselekileyo, buyela umva kuphela xa kukhuselekile kwaye uphephe nantoni na evala umbono okanye ulawulo.
xh.explanation: Le misebenzi isebenza nokuba akukho mqondiso othile wendlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.65 — Driving while impaired

en.title: Never drive while impaired
en.key_point: Do not drive or ride when alcohol, medication or another substance makes you unsafe to control the vehicle.
en.explanation: The safest learner rule is simple: impairment and driving do not mix. The app does not teach learners to calculate how much of an intoxicating substance they could use before driving.

af.title: Moet nooit bestuur wanneer jy aangetas is nie
af.key_point: Moenie bestuur of motorfiets ry wanneer alkohol, medikasie of 'n ander middel jou onveilig maak om die voertuig te beheer nie.
af.explanation: Die veilige reël is eenvoudig: as jou oordeel of beheer aangetas is, moet jy nie bestuur nie.

xh.title: Musa ukuqhuba xa uchaphazelekile
xh.key_point: Musa ukuqhuba okanye ukukhwela isithuthuthu xa utywala, iyeza okanye enye into ikwenza ungakwazi ukulawula isithuthi ngokukhuselekileyo.
xh.explanation: Umgaqo wokhuseleko ulula: ukuba isigqibo okanye ulawulo lwakho luchaphazelekile, musa ukuqhuba.

source.locator: South African Government learner's licence service — Code 1

en.title: Learner's licence Code 1
en.key_point: Code 1 is the learner's licence category for motorcycles, including a motorcycle with or without a sidecar, motor tricycle or quadrucycle.
en.explanation: The national government service page currently uses the learner-licence labels Code 1, Code 2 and Code 3. Driving-licence categories such as A1 or A are a separate classification.

af.title: Leerderlisensie Kode 1
af.key_point: Kode 1 is die leerderlisensie-kategorie vir motorfietse, insluitend 'n motorfiets met of sonder 'n syspan, motordriewiel of vierwielmotorfiets.
af.explanation: Die nasionale diens gebruik steeds die leerderkodes 1, 2 en 3; finale bestuurslisensiekategorieë word apart geklassifiseer.

xh.title: Ilayisensi yomfundi Ikhowudi 1
xh.key_point: Ikhowudi 1 ludidi lwelayisensi yomfundi yezithuthuthu, kuquka isithuthuthu esine-sidecar okanye esingenayo, i-motor tricycle okanye i-quadrucycle.
xh.explanation: Inkonzo yesizwe isasebenzisa iiKhowudi 1, 2 no-3 zabafundi; iindidi zelayisensi yokuqhuba zahlukile.

source.locator: South African Government learner's licence service — Code 2

en.title: Learner's licence Code 2
en.key_point: Code 2 covers motor vehicles other than motorcycles with a gross vehicle mass not exceeding 3 500 kg.
en.explanation: The national government service page currently includes light motor vehicles, minibuses, buses and goods vehicles within that mass limit.

af.title: Leerderlisensie Kode 2
af.key_point: Kode 2 dek motorvoertuie anders as motorfietse met 'n bruto voertuigmassa van hoogstens 3 500 kg.
af.explanation: Dit sluit ligte motorvoertuie en ander voertuie binne daardie massalimiet in.

xh.title: Ilayisensi yomfundi Ikhowudi 2
xh.key_point: Ikhowudi 2 igubungela izithuthi ezingezizo izithuthuthu ezinobunzima obupheleleyo obungagqithiyo kwi-3 500 kg.
xh.explanation: Oku kuquka iimoto ezilula nezinye izithuthi ezingaphakathi kwaloo mda wobunzima.

source.locator: South African Government learner's licence service — validity and supervision

en.title: Learner's licence validity and supervision
en.key_point: A learner's licence is valid for 24 months. Learner drivers must be supervised by a licensed driver when the vehicle category requires it.
en.explanation: Motorcycle learner rules differ from ordinary motor vehicles, so the app keeps Code 1 and Code 2 pathways separate.

af.title: Geldigheid en toesig van 'n leerderlisensie
af.key_point: 'n Leerderlisensie is 24 maande geldig. Leerderbestuurders moet deur 'n gelisensieerde bestuurder toesig gehou word waar die voertuigkategorie dit vereis.
af.explanation: Motorfietsreëls verskil van gewone motorvoertuie, daarom bly Kode 1 en Kode 2 apart.

xh.title: Ixesha lokusebenza kwelayisensi yomfundi nokugadwa
xh.key_point: Ilayisensi yomfundi isebenza iinyanga ezingama-24. Umfundi kufuneka agadiwe ngumqhubi onelayisensi apho udidi lwesithuthi lufuna njalo.
xh.explanation: Imithetho yezithuthuthu iyahluka kweyeemoto eziqhelekileyo, ngoko iKhowudi 1 neKhowudi 2 zigcinwa zahlukile.

source.locator: Western Cape Government learner's licence service — preparing for your test

en.title: Official study scope
en.key_point: The official preparation scope is Rules of the Road, Road Signs and Markings, and Vehicle Controls.
en.explanation: The Western Cape Government currently links learners directly to the NaTIS study material for these three areas and also states that printed learner manuals have been supplied to selected public libraries.

af.title: Amptelike studiesomvang
af.key_point: Die amptelike voorbereidingsomvang is Padreëls, Padtekens en -merke, en Voertuigkontroles.
af.explanation: Hierdie drie domeine vorm die bronbeheerde kern van die app se leerinhoud.

xh.title: Umda wokufunda osemthethweni
xh.key_point: Umda wokulungiselela osemthethweni yiMithetho yeNdlela, iMiqondiso neeMpawu zeNdlela, kunye noLawulo lweSithuthi.
xh.explanation: Ezi ndawo zintathu zenza isiseko esilawulwa yimithombo somxholo wokufunda we-app.
